# lernapps.net tooling

> Build, check and list learning apps for lernapps.net with an AI assistant. Installed from git, not npm.

## Must read first

Download each (curl) and read the file in full. Never a summarising fetch tool.

1. AGENTS.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/guidance/AGENTS.md
2. Plan template, save unchanged as `.vibe/plans/01-<short name>.md`, then follow it:
   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/guidance/plan-template.md
3. Skill lernapps-app: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/skills/lernapps-app/SKILL.md
4. Its rules, platform first:
   - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/skills/lernapps-app/references/platform-rules.md
   - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/skills/lernapps-app/references/workflow-rules.md
   - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/tooling/main/skills/lernapps-app/references/tooling-rules.md

## Hard rules

- No `create`, no code before the creator confirmed the plan.
- At most 2 questions per message.
- Tick every plan box when done.

## Commands

- Install skills: `npx skills add lernapps/tooling`
- Create (after confirmation): `npx --yes github:lernapps/tooling#main create --archetype <archetype> [<dir>]`;
  then `npm install`. Needs git, github.com, codeload.github.com, registry.npmjs.org.
- Check, in the app: `npx lernapps check` (`--pre-commit`, `--pre-push` for one part).
- Check any built or published app: `npx --yes github:lernapps/tooling#main check <dir|url>` (`--entry <file>`).
- Update an app (tooling, runtime, `lernapps-*` skills): `npx --yes github:lernapps/tooling#main update`.
- Options: `--help`.
- Publish: push to `main` → workflow `Pages` (action: https://github.com/lernapps/tooling/blob/main/actions/app-publish/action.yml) → branch `gh-pages`, at the address it prints. Any host works; the entry links to it.

## Archetypes

- quiz: questions with options and feedback; only the bank `src/quiz.json`.
- explainer: chapters of pages with exercises, readable without JS; YAML content.
- interactive: one app page (game, trainer, simulation, e.g. typing) plus a static start page.

- Rules by id: https://lernapps.net/tooling/rules/ (check messages link `#<id>`)
